reviews.text:
We visited the facility before leaving our cat and met Marika and Michael, who immediately instilled trust and professionalism in us.
The space dedicated to the cats is truly beautiful, well-kept, and welcoming. It was our first experience in a cattery, and we can say we were truly thrilled. Especially Blu, our 8-month-old cat, who upon returning home was as serene, relaxed, and cuddly as ever.
Throughout our stay, we received updates with photos and videos several times a day, a kindness that made us feel at ease and close to her.
Definitely a safe and reliable place for Blu, the interina 🖤💙, and a source of great peace of mind for us whenever we're away. Highly recommended!

Fantastic and super helpful!

We left our Sally with Mike and Marika for 3-4 nights and had a wonderful time. Not much to say: it was a truly positive experience!
They ask for a few days of trial to let the dog settle in, as is right, to build a bond and make her feel comfortable.
During our stay, we received photos and videos of our Sally, who has become very fond of the owners of the boarding house.
Constant updates, great professionalism, and dedication.
We already know who to contact next time ❤️🐶
Thank you for everything! ❤️

I met Marika and Michael and visited the cattery: wonderful people, competent and attentive to the needs of animals in general, as well as the clean, well-equipped, and safe place. We entrusted them with Gattopardo and Macchiavelli for their first New Year's Eve: they returned home happy and well-behaved. We entrusted them to them at Carnival, and it didn't take long to see them scampering up and down the paths and being all cuddly. They are our safe haven when we have to go away, a place where we know our kittens feel at home. I highly recommend them if you're looking for a place full of love and expertise.

A truly positive experience! So much so that my Pippo was thrilled to socialize with other dogs, and they're also very competent and care about making both our furry friends and us happy, with constant photos and videos!
Love and cuddles for everyone!
So much so that my Pippo was sad and miserable for a whole day after his stay because he wanted to go back to playing with his friends!
A clean place, no cages, but everyone was beautiful and happy together!
Thank you so much for everything, but especially for letting Pippo stay so full of love and attention, even away from us owners!

I took my Jack Russell Apollo to both daycare and boarding, and I couldn't be happier. Marika and Michael are attentive, knowledgeable, and truly passionate: throughout his stay, they kept me updated with lots of photos and videos, making me feel at ease. They also gave me helpful advice on his behavior. After leaving him with them for a few days, he even improved on walks! Apollo adores them; every time we pass by the door, he wants to come in 😄 A sign that he truly feels at home there. Highly recommended!

Since we love our Luna like she was another child, we were nervous when we first dropped her off at daycare. But Mike's expertise and charisma, along with Marika's sweetness and professionalism, ensured that Luna felt great, cared for and pampered as if she were at home. We therefore decided to have her go regularly once a week. When Luna arrives at daycare in the morning, we can't hold her back because she immediately wants to go inside and play with her friends. This is the best and most sincere sign that our beloved furry friends are treated with love and great care. We are very happy with our choice. We highly recommend the daycare. As soon as the need arises, we will also take advantage of the boarding facility.

We left our dog Sally at the Fusa Bau Resort while we were abroad, and we couldn't have made a better choice. Marica and Michael were professional, attentive, and incredibly sweet during the settling-in process, ensuring Sally had a peaceful stay. We were kept updated with videos and photos, which gave us great peace of mind. Thank you so much for treating her with such love. You've become a trusted source of care, and we recommend you without hesitation.

I left my Husky with them for 6 days.
I really enjoyed their approach, from the gradual introduction phase, where they explained their method to me, to the actual boarding, where they kept me constantly updated, even sending me photos and videos.
But above all, the most important feedback came from my dog: every time we passed by, he started pulling to get in, so I'm sure HE felt great!

They're truly fantastic! I've been taking Bruno to them for a while now and have always had a great experience. Bruno is always happy to go there, and that's the most important confirmation for me.

Communication with the entire staff is simple, fast, and always very friendly. They're helpful, attentive, and you can tell they truly love dogs. Knowing Bruno is in good hands gives me great peace of mind 🙏🏽❤️

I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and professional place to leave their dog.

We brought our cat for a short stay, and we had a wonderful time. The owners are knowledgeable, professional, helpful, and friendly. We were able to access videos and news throughout our absence. They will definitely be our go-to place for future reference.

I didn't think Nina, a Jack Pinscher mix—very wary and fearful—would be able to stay at the shelter. Her adjustment is happening gradually, and thanks to Marika and Michael's patience, professionalism, and gentle, sensitive approach, she's adapting to the situation more and more each day. Now, when she sees me bringing her there, she even shows signs of happiness. It's early days, and we still have a long way to go before she's
completely comfortable, but the regular updates with videos and messages, besides reassuring me 😅, will be a diary of the incredible evolution Nina is making while she's there, always under the watchful eye of Marika and Michael as she socializes with humans and other shelter friends. Let's see how things go in the next few days.

Excellent experience for both boarding and daycare! No cages and lots of love. My Golden Retriever had so much fun, actively stimulated through play, exercise, and socialization. Michael and Marika are wonderful, loving, and very knowledgeable! 100% recommended, I saw my puppy happy to go play and stay with them!

I wanted to try their facility because I followed them on social media. I really liked their method and the fact that I saw the dogs so calm and happy. I trusted them and their advice after an introductory meeting, and we started a daycare program for my dog, Whisky, with a view to eventually boarding him. It was a necessary process given my dog's distrust of any human other than me. 😂
I started this program with some doubts and fears, especially because of my dog's personality, and I have to say they did an extraordinary job! Trusting their advice and following the program together was the best choice I could have made.
Whisky now plays with the other dogs, doesn't fight, and is even embracing his relationships with humans (in his own way 😂).
The place is spotless despite the large number of furry friends there every day, no cages, and everyone is happy playing together, which is the best thing ever.
The guys are extremely available for any request, and are very attentive even to anxious owners (like me 😂), sending constant updates via photos and videos.
Very convenient hours and packages for any type of need.
I'm very happy I chose them, and I'm more than happy and at peace knowing that my dog ​​is in good hands!
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 🐾 🐺 😊

I'm super happy to have found a daycare center where my Trixie is super pampered by competent and loving people and despite her bad temper she has some new furry friends🥰 the daycare center is in a large, super clean, tidy space and in a beautiful building next to lots of green spaces and the real countryside of the Ticinello agricultural park.

Anyone who has a pet knows it: it's a love that knows no bounds, and, as with a loved one, we would do anything for his well-being. My Pino has been entrusted to Pet Glow for almost two years now, first for grooming and now also for daycare, and we both couldn't be happier. Fusa Bau Resort isn't just a place where Pino spends the day when my commitments prevent me from caring for him as I'd like: it's precious time for him to play, socialize, and learn. Yes, he learns, because Marika and Michael do everything they can to make Pino's stay productive in terms of education, which is a huge help for me: in just a few days, Pino has learned not to pull on the leash and to be more relaxed in social situations! Furthermore, these guys are not only huge and true animal lovers, but they are the first in the industry to truly understand the feeling of love that binds a pet to its human: during Pino's stay, I receive photos, videos, updates on his progress (and even on the mischief he gets up to), or even signs of physical and mental distress (like a slightly red eye or excessive barking). Above all, I perceive constant, timely, and sincere attention to the well-being of my dog ​​and all the puppies they care for. My dog ​​is the most precious thing I have, and there are few people I would trust with his care, but Fusa Bau definitely ranks first!

I left my greyhound at the Fusa Bau Resort for a week. He was very nervous at first, but the staff was amazing: with patience and lots of cuddles, they managed to calm him down and make him feel at home. We were always kept up to date, and he was happy again. Professional and very sweet, highly recommended!

Marika and Michael immediately empathized with my terrified dog. I immediately felt safe with them, and we took advantage of the boarding facility for her. Constant updates were provided to make the owner feel at ease, too. Excellent experience.
I recommend this dog boarding facility (and daycare) to everyone. The staff is super attentive.
Thanks guys, see you soon ❤️

We left our big puppy at Marika and Michael's boarding kennels, and the experience was truly wonderful. They sent us constant updates, and we could see how much he was loved and cared for, just as if he were at home with us. I highly recommend him!
I used the cattery and couldn't have asked for better attention and care for my kitten. Superb professionalism and affection. I will recommend it to everyone.

The staff at Pura Bau Resort connected with my dog ​​very quickly, despite his challenging personality and size. The relationship we developed with them also bore unexpected fruit during our walks, much to the relief of everyone's shoulders.
My dog ​​Sigmund was pampered, loved, and spoiled the entire time he was at the boarding house. Marika and Michael are fantastic and truly love animals.
I'm extremely satisfied with the staff's service. They were kind, helpful, and affectionate with my dog. They were attentive and impeccable in communicating with the owners. I highly recommend them.

Truly highly trained professionals, I recommend them to anyone who wants to give their furry friend the opportunity to spend days socializing and playing. Fusa Bau employs exceptional people who are capable of finding the best solution for each client, paying attention to their history and needs.
Thanks to you, our kitten has been incredibly pampered, and we can rest easy when we have to go away and can't take her with us. Thank you! Pia and Leonella (Milky's moms)
Super positive experience. Constant updates on the management of Cucciolone and super nice and friendly guys. We'll be back. Woof 🫶🏽 …
What can I say? They treated our greyhound very well, helping him settle in and showing great patience during the most difficult moments. Highly recommended, well done!
Excellent boarding house! Very kind and attentive to the cats' well-being. Clean, organized, and safe. I'll definitely be back.

Michael and Marika are very reliable, serious, and competent. The place is very clean and well-kept.
From the initial placement to the actual daycare period, they were always available and attentive to ensuring the well-being of our puppy, who, since attending Bau Resort, has become more sociable with other dogs. I can also confirm that when you drop off your puppies, you will always be informed and updated because they will always send you videos and photos of your dog. We are very happy and grateful to be able to count on Bau Resort.

It's the only dog ​​boarding facility in Milan where our little Zoe is always happy to go :)
Plus, the owners are two very professional and helpful people. Highly recommended!
Good and professional... but above all you can see that they love animals ☺️

Highly recommended! We entrusted Marika and Michael with our shy and fearful cat, who had never been in a cattery before. They were incredibly helpful and attentive to his needs. They helped him settle in, and in his own time, he was able to trust and make friends with the other cats at the cattery. They sent me photos every day and kept me updated on his progress. I will definitely trust them again! They were fantastic 🥰🥰🥰

A truly super positive experience! We dropped off our 6-year-old cat, who had never been in a cattery before, and naturally we were a little worried about how she would cope with this new experience.

Marika and Michael were excellent: attentive, helpful, and above all, very affectionate with her. What we really appreciated was the space the cats had: large, welcoming spaces, no cages, with the ability to roam freely, play, and explore.

When we returned, we found our cat serene, calm, and happy, and for us, this was the best confirmation that she had truly enjoyed herself.

It's clear that Marika and Michael love cats and know how to care for them while respecting their time and temperament. Now we know where to leave her with peace of mind when we need her. Highly recommended!

PS. Before we left, we took the opportunity to remove a few knots! Superb service! Also because she gets a little annoyed...
🐱❤️

We left our Tequila at this boarding house for a month and had a wonderful time! 🥰
Tequila arrived at just one year old and was very scared, so much so that they had some difficulty settling in during the first few weeks. Despite this, they showed truly rare patience, kindness, and dedication. They continued to build a relationship with her with such tenderness, respecting her pace and never forcing her. It was wonderful for us to see her progress, even from a distance, and to know that she was in the care of people who truly cared about her well-being. Throughout the month, they kept in constant contact with us, sending us photos and updates, which made us feel much more at ease and close to her. We are truly happy we chose this boarding house for Tequila and would definitely entrust her to them again. Thank you so much to the staff for the care, patience, and affection they gave her! ❤️

Your little devil sends you his regards 😈😈

This is our first boarding experience, and I was very nervous about leaving our Jerry there for two weeks. But he had a great time; it made our cat more affectionate and welcoming. Highly recommended. The staff were wonderful and attentive, sending daily updates. Jerry went home feeling very happy.

This wonderful place has become my beloved Bingo's second home. Michael and Marika are well-trained, professional, and above all, passionate about what they do, a key factor in establishing a daycare/boarding facility like this. For us, it's not just a safe place to leave our puppy when needed, but a place to provide her with moments of recreation, socialization, and discipline. After two weeks of boarding, she's calm, happy, and above all at peace. Heartfelt thanks to the Fusabau Resort team.
We found a place where our twelve-year-old Maltese Cali is happy! Usually it's a tragedy to leave him, but here he's obviously treated well, and the kids know how to handle it. Thanks for everything.

Brioche has stayed at several catteries in Milan, including the most popular ones... I've never felt so at peace leaving her at a cattery as I did at Fusabau, and I've never seen Brioche so calm and yet energetic! The kitten has developed a bond with her two attentive and dedicated owners. By keeping a smaller number of cats than other catteries, they are able to ensure greater attention to their furry guests. Regular updates and flexible check-in and check-out times are provided.
